name: Lucas
bio:
I am Lucas, born and raised in the Arusha region of Tanzania. My family's roots lie in the Kilimanjaro region with the Chagga tribe, and over a century ago, they settled along the slopes of Mount Meru. Growing up in this lush environment, my guiding dream was sparked by my grandfather, who was a coffee farmer. For over a decade, I lived with him on his large estate, where we cultivated coffee, bananas, vegetables, and flowers. The greenery attracted numerous bird species and small animals, which my grandfather protected and appreciated.
Inspired by his love for nature, I developed a passion for flora, fauna, and wildlife, learning about them in our local language. After high school, I pursued my interest in the tourism industry, studying at the Arusha College of Tourism and then specializing at PROTS in professional tour guiding.
I have worked with several safari companies, guiding in Tanzania's parks, conservation areas, cultural sites, and town tours. I take pride in using my expertise to offer authentic safari experiences in Tanzania, where I can share my knowledge and perspective with people from around the world. One of my most unique experiences has been witnessing the incredible migration of over 2 million wildebeests and zebras, as they journey from southern Serengeti across the Mara River to the Maasai Mara ecosystem.
You're warmly welcome to explore Tanzania with Mazingira Safaris and create unforgettable safari memories! Thanks!
